title:
Rafael Jódar apologizes after the ball kid incident in Shanghai:

"After the match, I thought about it and I shouldn’t have done that to the ball kid. It was my mistake. I was very frustrated because of how the match was going for me. I didn’t mean to hurt the feelings of the ball kid or anything. I’ll try not to do it again because that’s not the right way to treat the ball kids, and I respect a lot their job".  

(...) I’m not perfect, I’m a human. I make mistakes. So I’ll learn from this mist
